# standards 0.0.12: highlights

The hand-written part of the release notes; scripts/release.py adds the rest.

* **Install with Homebrew or from the AUR**: `brew install sebastienrousseau/tap/standards-sync`, or `standards-sync` from the AUR with any helper. The README and `docs/packaging.md` show both.
